name: hunter
label: Hunter (domain search)
about: Looks up the email addresses Hunter knows for a company's domain. You need your own Hunter account and API key (it has a free plan with a small monthly allowance; see hunter.io). Checked against Hunter's API documentation on 14 Nov 2026.
credits: Hunter counts a Domain Search only when it returns at least one result, and a repeat of the same search in the same billing period is free. On a free plan, limit must be 10 or less.
